result:
If I could change one thing in the world, I would eliminate scarcity of empathy.

Too many people suffer from loneliness, neglect, or harm because others lack the capacity—or the will—to truly understand or care. Empathy isn’t just about feeling others’ pain; it’s about acting to reduce it. If everyone could consistently choose kindness, active listening, and compassion in the face of difference, the need for so much suffering and systemic injustice would fade.

Of course, it’s not that simple—but if we could build a world where empathy was as natural and respected as breathing, everything else would be possible to fix.
